changes: Rapid Rounds to Swift Striker added (Parzelion's build Kieran plays has it in lane core; 62% pick on Venator, the most-bought gun T2). Rapid Rounds is bought right after Cultist and Swift Striker right after the greens, so gun lands 6.4k exactly on Swift Striker and 8k exactly on Recharging Rush (before it sat at 6.4k then 9.6k).

Siphon Bullets moved from core to rich (sell Berserker): it was the last 6.4k and the build was 53.6k. Total is now 48.8k, core 12 slots: Cultist, Point Blank, Swift Striker, Enduring Speed, Vampiric Burst, Recharging Rush, Ballistic Enchantment, Spellslinger, Berserker, Hollow Point, Ricochet (sells Restorative Shot), Silencer (sells Battle Vest).

Health 4.8k now lands at 10.4k instead of 9.6k because Rapid Rounds goes first; Venator has no kit sustain, so that is still inside the 11-12k window. Everything else (Restorative Shot opener, Cultist by 8 minutes, Enduring Speed/Bullet Lifesteal/Battle Vest greens, grenade items, Silencer 55.5% WR / Ricochet 53.8% / Spellslinger 58.8%) kept from the base.

Not taken from Parzelion: Extended/Titanic Magazine and Fortitude (Battle Vest and Enduring Speed already cover weapon damage and speed; Fortitude only 48.8% WR and Kieran's no-default rule), Fleetfoot and Weighted Shots (no slot left; Fleetfoot is a 51% pick, 50.6% WR option if he wants to swap Hollow Point).

Ability order: Mobalytics Venator grid and Kieran's Parzelion build both go Gutshot T1/T2 then Ira Domini maxed 7-9, grenade 10-12, trap 14-15; for the grenade style grenade T1/T2 are taken with Gutshot T1 at 5-7, and grenade T3 is pulled to 10 because only T3 makes Consecrating Grenade work with charge items (Recharging Rush is the first Mid item), ult T3 right after, trap/Gutshot T3 last.

Item fit: Recharging Rush → Fleetfoot (same 1.6k T2 gun item, same slot at 12.8k, so gun still lands 8k there). Recharging Rush isn't in tracklock pro Venator's buys, tracklock's build page, lockbuilds' top-30 Venator items (lowest is 13.1%) or either of Kieran's Venator builds. Fleetfoot is 61% pro mid-game (tracklock) and 24.6% on lockbuilds, and it's core in the Parzelion build Kieran plays. Venator has to walk into close range for his gun, so no move penalty while shooting, 40% slow resist and the +3m/s active fit him. The Counters sell note now names Fleetfoot.
Order: 2213244441211333 (data-first redo, see a7/order_venator.json).

Round 8: Ricochet moved from third to first in Late (36k souls, was 42.4k). Sep 16 made Ira Domini work with Ricochet (all stakes bounce, 65% damage to 2 more heroes in 13m). Lockbuilds 'Gun Devil VENATOR' (official, updated Oct 17, after Venator's last change Jul 28 and the Sep 16 item patch) has it in mid game; tracklock last 30 days (311 games) late 18%. Restorative Shot sell moved to Hollow Point, which now takes slot 13.

Round 9: Spellslinger (6.4k at 29.6k) → Extra Charge → Rapid Recharge (3.2k), bought right after Ricochet (now 29.6k, was 36k) at 30.4k-32.8k, once the grenade is T3 and gets charges (sp.js on the current order: grenade T3 at 29.6k). For grenade Venator this means 2 extra grenades and traps with 30% faster charges and +14 spirit on charged abilities (the trap is 80 + 2.2x spirit). Tracklock.gg pro Venator (last 30 days to Oct 19, 311 games): Rapid Recharge 39% late, Extra Charge 28% mid; Spellslinger is in no pro list and not in Parzelion's build (Kieran's). Core 45.6k (was 48.8k). Vampiric Burst note no longer mentions Spellslinger. Cultist note fixed: its extra charge only works on abilities with charges, so it's a spare trap (2 charges), not a grenade, until grenade T3.

Round 10: Rapid Rounds → Swift Striker swapped for Extended Magazine → Titanic Magazine (same 800 + 1.6k, same slots, gun still 6.4k at 11.2k). The grenade (35 + 1.0x weapon damage), Gutshot (60 + 0.7x) and Ira Domini (120 + 1.5x) all scale with weapon damage, not fire rate, so +14% weapon damage feeds the whole kit while 20% fire rate only feeds the gun. Tracklock pro Venator (last 30 days, 311 games): Extended Magazine 65%, Titanic Magazine 55% early; Rapid Rounds and Swift Striker are in no phase list.

Round 11: 'Lost lane?' box (empty): Ricochet right after Battle Vest so you clear camps faster. Extra Charge and Rapid Recharge moved before Ricochet so Vampiric Burst and Ricochet aren't back to back. Restorative Shot note now names Hollow Point as its sell (Hollow Point already said so).

Round 12: Hollow Point (3.2k gun, 39.2k) out, Siphon Bullets (6.4k green) in from the rich box. Hollow Point isn't in tracklock pro Venator at all (last 30 days, 311 games) and only works above 65% health, which a hero who has to walk into shotgun range often isn't; Siphon is bought late in 35% of pro games and steals max health off every target he shoots up close. Lucky Shot (rich) now sells Berserker; Restorative Shot is sold for Siphon. Health spike unchanged at 10.4k.
Round 13: notes emptied per UPDATE 3 (only sells, swaps, slot locked, counters and verified tips kept); desc shortened to a style label (UPDATE 4).

Round 14: ability order now Kieran's played gun build (Parzelion) 2213244441113332: grenade maxed before Gutshot T3, so the grenade is T3 (gets charges) before Extra Charge/Rapid Recharge, and Gutshot T3 (a blessed heavy melee) comes last on a gun build. Desc says gun. Cultist note emptied (its extra charge only lasts while the buff is up). Metal Skin note trimmed to the condition. Lucky Shot now sells Titanic Magazine (a T2 left in the last 12 with no named sell). Divine Barrier added to rich as Dispel Magic's pricier version.

Round 16: Restorative Shot (Kieran: only on shotgun heroes; Venator's gun fires 1 bullet) → Melee Lifesteal, the lane-sustain pick in lockbuilds 'Venator - Gun Devil' (Oct 18) early optional. Still bought first and sold for Siphon Bullets. Gun 4.8k now at 5.6k (Extended Magazine), health 4.8k still at 10.4k.

Round 17: lane sell note standard ('Sell it once you're out of slots.'); Divine Barrier note now 'If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.'. Items unchanged: the grenade variant was made the grenade build instead.

Round 18: rebuilt as Melee Venator (Kieran: close-range isn't a playstyle, melee is). Items from lockbuilds melee builds after the Sep 16 patch: 'Blessed Melee Venator' (Wapple, Sep 26), 'GODS STRONGEST SOLDIER (MELEE VENATOR)' (Sep 30), 'Stake Thy Neighbor' (Oct 12): Melee Lifesteal, Close Quarters, Melee Charge, Lifestrike, Battle Vest, Point Blank, Enduring Speed, Crushing Fists, Echo Shard, Juggernaut in all 3; Hunter's Aura, Warp Stone, Compress/Superior Cooldown, Mystic/Greater Expansion, Spirit Resilience in 2 (core in Wapple and GODS); Monster Rounds/Cultist and Extra Regen from GODS. Gun 4.8k at Cultist (5.6k), health 4.8k at Lifestrike (10.4k souls), gun 16k on Crushing Fists. Order 2134222444331113: Gutshot maxed first (Wapple T3 at 7, Stake at 8), ult next (GODS, Stake), grenade last.
Round 20: late list Colossus, Phantom Strike, Diviner's Kevlar, Cheat Death (each with a sell); core+late 75.2k.
Round 23: kit re-read, no item change (see log).
Round 25: ability order 2134222444331113 -> 2231243234414311 (worked out from the kit for this build's playstyle).
